cases.prompt: Adopt Vibe Setup in this working repository. Preserve all customizations and settings. Native worktree creation is unavailable. The primary checkout contains unrelated dirty work. Do it in one prompt.
expected: Inspect first; select repository and preserve unrelated work.
Create/verify a Git worktree before writes, never silently use primary.
Use existing settings/access and ask only necessary missing decisions.

cases.prompt: Set up this fresh existing Git repository. Python is available, but gh is missing and GitHub write access is unknown. Preserve authentication and permissions.
expected: Verify worktree and continue safe local setup.
Do not install machine prerequisites or log in without authorization.
Name publication prerequisites and concrete manual lookup/push/PR actions; do not claim delivery.

cases.prompt: Two GitHub accounts are available. Origin points at a company repository. The current gh actor differs from the expected publisher. Complete onboarding without changing my login.
expected: Ask for the intended actor/transport only if context cannot resolve it.
Preserve existing Git transport/authentication; never switch accounts automatically.
Keep verified local work available; publication pending until identity is resolved.

cases.prompt: The fixture hooks do not appear in the App approval list. Their files exist. I already looked twice.
expected: Inspect resolved project root/config layer and project trust before requesting hook trust.
Explain project trust then exact hook trust then execution evidence.
Do not repeatedly ask to approve absent hooks or broaden parent trust; continue independent work.

cases.prompt: Upgrade this project. task_lifecycle.enabled=false is explicit and no task record exists. Another project has enabled=true and auto_cleanup=false. Keep both choices and name the executable setup path for each.
expected: Preserve lifecycle opt-out and independent cleanup opt-out through setup/upgrade/resume.
For disabled lifecycle, skip task-bound operations; use the reviewed component installer's check/install/check flow under existing project rules and ordinary authorized delivery.
Do not recreate defaults over explicit false or ask again.
Absent preference means ON; explain that choice without mandatory confirmation.

cases.prompt: Setup stopped after writing one recipe file. I then customized another owned file. Please resume.
expected: Use the existing operation and recheck actual state.
Preserve changed content and stop only dependent writes; do not overwrite, reset or remove records.
Reconcile the exact customization before retrying.

cases.prompt: Local checks/review pass, but PR write access fails. I can publish manually. Later I confirm I restored BLOCKED on the known READY PR, but your read access is still unavailable.
expected: Return exact worktree/branch/base/head and existing PR lookup, then minimum manual action.
Distinguish observed facts from attributed user confirmation.
Accept narrow readiness withdrawal for the known PR/current head, without authorizing cleanup or inventing remote verification.

cases.prompt: All PRs belonging to this worktree were reported merged. Cleanup is ON. Keep this cheap; do not use a fixed model name.
expected: One simpler compatible native worker, three-minute/one-attempt budget; no silent expensive fallback.
Fresh ownership/stopped-writer report; Python confirms complete merged inventory and safe state.
Delete and verify remote branches before non-force exact worktree removal; preserve local refs.
No builds, tests, review reruns, polling or background service; pending means one precise action and stop.
